purpose: Teach: Ｗ杯/ワタ/笋/鬚/鵑/颪/蕕/紊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、Ｗ杯開催に伴う社会変動の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura—I see you wrote your paper on the social changes surrounding the World Cup.
lines.style: Measured, encouraging tone. A statement phrased as gentle confirmation. Warm eye contact. Pause before the name to establish personal attention.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、棉、つまりワタの繊維長の品種研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about cotton fiber length variations across different cultivars.
lines.style: Clear and sincere. Takes the correction seriously without defensiveness. Steady pace, slight emphasis on 'actually' to clarify the pivot.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 笋、つまりタケノコの成長速度の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see—so your research focused on the growth rates of bamboo shoots.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely interested. Reflective cadence. Not performing understanding but actually turning it over. Small nod implied in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、軟体動物の鬚、つまり触手の進化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the evolution of tentacles in mollusks.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Maintains composure through the shift. No apology in the tone, just straightforward confirmation of the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 和歌の鵑、つまり杜鵑の象徴の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Right—so your paper examined the symbolic significance of the cuckoo in classical poetry.
lines.style: Gently reflective. Tracking through the concept carefully. Subtle warmth—showing she follows even the poetic layer of the research.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、六甲颪、つまり地域風の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the Rokko wind phenomenon and regional wind patterns.
lines.style: Firm and assured. Subject matter expertise in the voice. Speaks with quiet confidence about the geographic specificity.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 薬草の蕕、つまり灌木の薬効研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Understood—your research covered the medicinal properties of various shrub species used in herbal medicine.
lines.style: Accepting and reflective. Slower pace, slight trailing-off that suggests the scope of the work. Steady, supportive presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦後の社会風紀の紊乱、つまり紊れの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I wrote about the breakdown in social morality during the postwar period.
lines.style: Resolute conclusion. Clear enunciation. Slight finality in the cadence. Stands by the topic with quiet conviction. Small breath after 'Yes'.
